correctness.rationale: Differentiating the Dirichlet gamma moment identity at mixed exponents gives the exact H-Q covariance. The rational term is strictly negative since A²-sum(alpha_i²)=2 sum_{i<j}alpha_i alpha_j>0; a weighted covariance of alpha with strictly increasing digamma is nonnegative. Along fixed-sum tangent vectors the second variation of V=-Cov is [2a(Ka+1)trigamma(a+1)-1]sum(v_i²)/[Ka(Ka+1)²(Ka+2)]. The integral a*trigamma(a+1)=integral_0^infty e^-u [(u/a)/(e^(u/a)-1)] du increases strictly from 0 to 1, hence exactly one positive threshold; strict local maximum before, minimum after, with no assertion at zero curvature. Independent numerical differentiation of raw gamma moments and closed formula agreed for five nonsymmetric/symmetric shape vectors to 6.1e-16; the symbolic argument, not finite checks, covers every positive real shape and integer K>=2.
residual_risks: No global shape-vector extremum is asserted. At the critical value where quadratic variation vanishes, higher-order behavior is not determined.
